# qarunner

> qarunner is a self-hosted regression test runner for pytest and Playwright. It runs existing test suites in throwaway Docker containers, keeps logs, Allure reports, Playwright artifacts and per-case results for every run, and compares each run with the most recent comparable run (same suite, runner and arguments) to report new failures, fixed cases, still-failing cases and flaky tests. It targets a single team on a trusted internal network; it has a FastAPI backend, a React web console and a REST API, and is deployed with Docker Compose. MIT licensed, alpha status.

Important notes:

- The current version must not run untrusted test code: the control plane mounts the host Docker socket. The target architecture with a separate worker host is not implemented yet.
- It is not a CI system, not a command-line tool and not multi-tenant. CI pipelines can trigger runs through the REST API.
- AI failure diagnosis (Anthropic or OpenAI) is optional and read-only; everything else works without an API key.
- Most design, requirements and operations documents are written in Chinese; the README, architecture overview, contributing guide and metric definitions are in English.
